answer: The copper schedule is applied in marble and haven shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1856 impostors cost 885 times the honest price and take 6 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
